tailwind-css-sr1-01.reason: ambiguous: 'static stylesheet during the build' contradicts the docs ('isn't one big static stylesheet') and fails for the Play CDN; cited Vite page did not support it. Rebuilt from verifier text, checked on styling-with-utility-classes. (final: keep)
tailwind-css-sr1-01.statement: Tailwind generates CSS for the utility classes it finds in your project when you compile your CSS.
tailwind-css-sr1-01.explanation: Tailwind isn't one big prebuilt stylesheet: it builds just the styles your classes need at compile time, which is how a one-off class like bg-[#316ff6] works.

tailwind-css-sr3-01.reason: tell: narrowing verb 'restricts' marked False 5/5 in the deck; reworded with a neutral verb, same fact (detection is plain-text, not HTML-attribute parsing) and same answer. (final: keep)
tailwind-css-sr3-01.statement: Tailwind finds utility candidates by parsing the class attributes in your HTML templates.
tailwind-css-sr3-01.explanation: Tailwind treats every source file as plain text and picks out class-like tokens wherever they appear, without parsing the file as code.
tailwind-css-sr3-01.misconception: Tailwind parses HTML class attributes instead of scanning source files as plain text.

tailwind-css-sr4-05.statement: Tailwind's disabled: variant matches a button that signals its state with aria-disabled="true" alone.
tailwind-css-sr4-05.explanation: disabled: compiles to :disabled, which needs the native disabled state; a button marked only with aria-disabled="true" needs Tailwind's aria-disabled: variant.
tailwind-css-sr4-05.misconception: Tailwind's disabled: variant also matches aria-disabled="true".

tailwind-css-sr4-06.statement: Tailwind's invalid: styles show on an empty required field before the user has typed anything.
tailwind-css-sr4-06.explanation: invalid: compiles to :invalid, which matches as soon as the value fails validation; Tailwind's user-invalid: variant waits until the user has interacted with the field.

tailwind-css-sr5-06.reason: tell: narrowing verb 'restricts' reworded; same fact (group-has searches the group's descendants) and same answer. (final: keep)

tailwind-css-sr5-06.explanation: group-has-[a]: runs its :has() check on the element marked group, so the link can sit anywhere inside that group.

tailwind-css-sr5-07.statement: Tailwind's in-focus: variant reacts to focus on any parent element, whether or not that parent has the group class.
tailwind-css-sr5-07.explanation: The in-* variants respond to a state change in any ancestor and need no marker class, so in-focus: also fires when an outer wrapper higher up receives focus.

tailwind-css-sr7-04.reason: tell: narrowing verb 'confines' reworded; same fact (@sm: is an open-ended minimum, not a band) and same answer. (final: fixed)
tailwind-css-sr7-04.statement: Tailwind's @sm: variant stops matching once its container reaches the @md size.
tailwind-css-sr7-04.explanation: Tailwind compiles @sm: to @container (width >= 24rem), a minimum with no upper bound, so its styles stay active as the container grows past @md.
tailwind-css-sr7-04.misconception: Named container variants represent size bands.
